summary: No relevant testing skill found. Core public UI cases now show enriched toasts: login failure shows 'Erreur 401 · Invalid credentials', duplicate registration shows 'Erreur 400 · Email already registered', pricing checkout with invalid lookup_key shows 'Erreur 400 · Price not found...', and logged-out homepage did not show a silent /auth/me 401 toast. However, the fix is not complete across all pages: AdminMediaForm triggers a user-visible runtime overlay 'showError is not defined' when its backend 404 error handler runs; source review also found AdminPage calls showError without importing it.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating as admin to /admin/media/does-not-exist/edit produces enriched 404 toast but also a user-visible dev runtime overlay: 'showError is not defined'. This means error handling is broken on this page.

integration_issues.issue: AdminMediaForm.jsx and AdminPage.jsx call showError in catch blocks but do not import it from @/lib/errors, so backend error paths can throw ReferenceError instead of cleanly handling errors on every page.

action_items: Retest admin backend-error paths such as invalid admin media edit and failing /admin/users to confirm there is no runtime overlay and the visible toast contains HTTP status + backend detail.
Consider adding a small frontend regression test for each page-level catch block that uses showError.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminMediaForm.jsx calls showError at lines 75, 95, and 133 but has no import for showError.
/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.jsx calls showError at lines 30, 55, and 64 but has no import for showError.

/app/frontend/src/lib/errors.js and /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly format axios/FastAPI errors as 'Erreur {status} · {detail}' and skip silent 401 probes, based on code inspection and UI evidence.

success_rate.frontend: 80%: login/register/pricing/home checks passed; admin media error path failed with runtime overlay

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the preview origin https://stream-portal-182.preview.emergentagent.com for UI tests; localhost:3000 causes CORS/network-error toasts because axios uses withCredentials against the preview backend. Pricing invalid lookup_key was tested by intercepting GET /api/plans to inject ym_nonexistent_plan, then clicking the real subscribe button so POST /api/payments/checkout and the axios interceptor were real. ErrorBoundary was code-inspected in App.js/ErrorBoundary.jsx but not force-triggered at runtime.
rca_of_the_issue: The main error formatting implementation works for global axios errors, but not all page-level catch blocks were wired correctly. AdminMediaForm.jsx and AdminPage.jsx were changed to call showError without importing it, producing ReferenceError on error paths. Reproduction: log in as admin, navigate to /admin/media/does-not-exist/edit, observe toast 'Erreur 404 · Not found' plus runtime overlay 'showError is not defined'.
